metadata.name: engolearn-placement-v3-test-sets
metadata.description: One DEV-only DRAFT snapshot; not published

items.label: A1 reading 1 — compact
items.passage: Lina comes from Spain. She now lives in Bristol.
items.explanation: Đáp án B: Bristol. Đối chiếu thông tin được nêu trong ngữ liệu riêng của câu này. Ngữ liệu: “Lina comes from Spain. She now lives in Bristol.”

items.label: A1 reading 2 — compact
items.passage: Lina lives with her sister Eva in a flat.
items.explanation: Đáp án A: Her sister. Đối chiếu thông tin được nêu trong ngữ liệu riêng của câu này. Ngữ liệu: “Lina lives with her sister Eva in a flat.”

items.label: A1 reading 3 — compact
items.passage: Lina studies English every morning. She works at weekends.
items.explanation: Đáp án D: English. Đối chiếu thông tin được nêu trong ngữ liệu riêng của câu này. Ngữ liệu: “Lina studies English every morning. She works at weekends.”

items.label: A1 reading 4 — compact
items.passage: Lina works in a bookshop on Saturdays.
items.explanation: Đáp án D: Saturdays. Đối chiếu thông tin được nêu trong ngữ liệu riêng của câu này. Ngữ liệu: “Lina works in a bookshop on Saturdays.”

items.label: A2 reading 1 — compact
items.passage: Your room opens at three. Arriving earlier? Reception can store your bags until then.
items.explanation: Đáp án B: Leave their bags. Khách có thể gửi hành lý; email không cho phép nhận phòng sớm. Ngữ liệu: “Your room opens at three. Arriving earlier? Reception can store your bags until then.”

items.label: A2 reading 2 — compact
items.passage: This shirt is too small. Could I exchange it? I like its colour.
items.explanation: Đáp án C: It doesn’t fit. Lý do đổi là kích thước, không phải màu hoặc thiết kế. Ngữ liệu: “This shirt is too small. Could I exchange it? I like its colour.”

items.label: A2 reading 3 — compact
items.passage: Road repairs have closed the bank stop. Hospital buses now leave outside the library.
items.explanation: Đáp án A: Road repairs. Thông báo nêu sửa đường; giá và thời gian hành trình không đổi. Ngữ liệu: “Road repairs have closed the bank stop. Hospital buses now leave outside the library.”

items.label: A2 reading 4 — compact
items.passage: Bring lunch on Friday’s trip: the café is closed. The school has paid for transport.
items.explanation: Đáp án D: Their lunch. Trường trả tiền xe; học sinh phải tự chuẩn bị bữa trưa. Ngữ liệu: “Bring lunch on Friday’s trip: the café is closed. The school has paid for transport.”

items.label: B1 reading 1 — compact
items.passage: Lacking paid experience, I described problems I’d solved while volunteering. The interviewer was interested; I was glad I’d applied.
items.explanation: Đáp án A: Volunteering can demonstrate skills. Kinh nghiệm tình nguyện cũng thể hiện kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề, không bảo đảm trúng tuyển. Ngữ liệu: “Lacking paid experience, I described problems I’d solved while volunteering. The interviewer was interested; I was glad I’d applied.”

items.label: B1 reading 2 — compact
items.passage: A cancelled boat trip led us to a wonderful village. Next holiday, we’ll book highlights but leave some days free.
items.explanation: Đáp án B: Allow more flexibility. Giữ kế hoạch cần thiết nhưng dành chỗ cho trải nghiệm ngoài dự kiến. Ngữ liệu: “A cancelled boat trip led us to a wonderful village. Next holiday, we’ll book highlights but leave some days free.”

items.label: B1 reading 3 — compact
items.prompt: Why is the new method better?
items.passage: Recording every unfamiliar word overwhelmed me. Choosing useful words and making personal examples helped me remember and use them.
items.explanation: Đáp án D: It supports practical recall. Chọn lọc và gắn từ với bản thân giúp nhớ và sử dụng, không phải ghi thật nhiều. Ngữ liệu: “Recording every unfamiliar word overwhelmed me. Choosing useful words and making personal examples helped me remember and use them.”

items.label: B2 reading 1 — compact
items.passage: The pilot cut waiting times, although staffing increased simultaneously. Describing the improvement as proof of the software’s success would therefore be premature.
items.explanation: Đáp án B: The claimed cause. Đối chiếu thông tin được nêu trong ngữ liệu riêng của câu này. Ngữ liệu: “The pilot cut waiting times, although staffing increased simultaneously. Describing the improvement as proof of the software’s success would therefore be premature.”

items.label: B2 reading 2 — compact
items.passage: Flexibility is welcome, provided it does not become an expectation that employees remain available whenever colleagues happen to work.
items.explanation: Đáp án A: Flexibility may extend availability. Đối chiếu thông tin được nêu trong ngữ liệu riêng của câu này. Ngữ liệu: “Flexibility is welcome, provided it does not become an expectation that employees remain available whenever colleagues happen to work.”

items.label: B2 reading 3 — compact
items.passage: The reviewer calls the exhibition ambitious, then observes that its explanations assume the very knowledge visitors are supposedly there to acquire.
items.explanation: Đáp án D: The presentation excludes beginners. Đối chiếu thông tin được nêu trong ngữ liệu riêng của câu này. Ngữ liệu: “The reviewer calls the exhibition ambitious, then observes that its explanations assume the very knowledge visitors are supposedly there to acquire.”

items.label: A1 listening 1 — compact
items.explanation: Đáp án B: Greenford. Đối chiếu thông tin được nêu trong ngữ liệu riêng của câu này. Ngữ liệu: “This train goes to Greenford. Please have your tickets ready before the doors close.”
items.transcript: This train goes to Greenford. Please have your tickets ready before the doors close.

items.label: A2 listening 1 — compact
items.prompt: How will the guest get the key?
items.explanation: Đáp án D: An entrance box. Khách lấy chìa khóa ở hộp bên cửa vì lễ tân đã đóng. Ngữ liệu: “Reception closes before you arrive tonight. Your key will be in a box beside the entrance. We have emailed the code; check in tomorrow morning.”
items.transcript: Reception closes before you arrive tonight. Your key will be in a box beside the entrance. We have emailed the code; check in tomorrow morning.

items.label: B1 listening 1 — compact
items.explanation: Đáp án D: To focus on action. Báo cáo tập trung vào tiến độ, vướng mắc và quyết định cần hỗ trợ. Ngữ liệu: “My detailed updates kept our meetings long. My manager needed progress, problems and decisions requiring help. I now report those first and keep the details available. Meetings lead to clearer action.”
items.transcript: My detailed updates kept our meetings long. My manager needed progress, problems and decisions requiring help. I now report those first and keep the details available. Meetings lead to clearer action.

items.label: B1 listening 2 — compact
items.explanation: Đáp án B: The opportunity was temporary. Lễ hội khó lặp lại còn lịch tham quan bảo tàng có thể dời. Ngữ liệu: “We’d planned a museum visit, but a café owner invited us to a festival that afternoon. The museum would be open tomorrow; the festival wouldn’t. We changed our plans.”
items.transcript: We’d planned a museum visit, but a café owner invited us to a festival that afternoon. The museum would be open tomorrow; the festival wouldn’t. We changed our plans.

items.label: B2 listening 3 — compact

options.label: D
options.text: The guide provides too few examples

items.explanation: Đáp án A: The detail may obscure priorities. Đối chiếu thông tin được nêu trong ngữ liệu riêng của câu này. Ngữ liệu: “The guide certainly contains plenty of information. Whether newcomers can find what matters among all that detail is another question. More isn’t automatically more helpful.”
items.transcript: The guide certainly contains plenty of information. Whether newcomers can find what matters among all that detail is another question. More isn’t automatically more helpful.

items.label: B2 listening 4 — compact
items.prompt: How should the response be understood?
items.explanation: Đáp án D: Conditional support. Đối chiếu thông tin được nêu trong ngữ liệu riêng của câu này. Ngữ liệu: “We support the aim, but we haven’t committed funding. First, we need a credible account of what would be reduced elsewhere to pay for it.”
items.transcript: We support the aim, but we haven’t committed funding. First, we need a credible account of what would be reduced elsewhere to pay for it.
